caption: The drawing depicts a single lidded vessel, centrally positioned within a rectangular border. The vessel is goblet-shaped, with a wide, rounded body that narrows towards the stem and then flares out to form a circular base. The lid is domed with a symmetrical, pinecone-like finial on top, textured with diamond-shaped patterns. The vessel features fine, detailed shading, giving it a metallic appearance, and includes engraved script initials “AMM” on the front of its body. The entire drawing is executed in gray and black tones, with tonal variation to suggest reflections and shadows. The artist's name, “AARON FASTOVSKY,” is inscribed in a small rectangular box in the lower right corner within the main frame. The drawing is set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
